events.description: Phoebe Buffay says the current situation is very intense.
Phoebe Buffay says one side of Phoebe Buffay's butt is currently numb.
Phoebe Buffay says the other side of Phoebe Buffay's butt currently has no idea that the first side is asleep.

Ross Geller tells Mr. Heckles to give Ross Geller's monkey back to Ross Geller.
Mr. Heckles says Mr. Heckles does not currently have a monkey.
Rachel Green asks Mr. Heckles why Mr. Heckles has so many bananas.

Ross Geller asks Mr. Heckles what Mr. Heckles has done to Marcel.
Mr. Heckles says Marcel is Mr. Heckles's monkey.
Mr. Heckles says Marcel is Patti the monkey.
Ross Geller says Mr. Heckles is insane.

Rachel Green urges Luisa Gianetti to relent regarding taking Marcel.

Ross Geller says Rachel Green was not fat in high school.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green was the prom queen in high school.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green was the homecoming queen in high school.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green was the class president in high school.
Rachel Green says Luisa Gianetti was also in high school with Rachel Green.
Rachel Green says Luisa Gianetti might take Marcel away.
Rachel Green says that if Luisa Gianetti takes Marcel, Rachel Green will lose Ross Geller, who is one of the most important people in Rachel Green's life.
Rachel Green says Luisa Gianetti can hate Rachel Green.
Rachel Green says Luisa Gianetti can do that if Luisa Gianetti wants to.
Rachel Green tells Luisa Gianetti not to punish Ross Geller.
Rachel Green says Luisa Gianetti has a chance to be the bigger person in this situation.
Rachel Green tells Luisa Gianetti to take the chance to be the bigger person.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green will call Luisa Gianetti's supervisor.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green will tell Luisa Gianetti's supervisor that Luisa Gianetti shot Ross Geller in the butt with a dart.
